svg.title: A dense layer needs 64 free weights to map a 4 by 4 input to 2 by 2; a convolution needs 9, shared
svg.desc: Two 4 by 16 matrices. Top, a dense layer with a different weight in each of the 64 cells. Bottom, the convolution's matrix: each row holds the nine kernel weights a to i at the positions of its window and zeros elsewhere; the same letters repeat, shifted, in every row.

g.text: dense layer: every output reads every pixel with its own weight
convolution with a 3 × 3 kernel: the same nine weights, shifted
9 weights (a to i), each used 4 times; the other 28 of the 64 entries are fixed at 0.
Columns are the 16 pixels of the 4 × 4 input, read row by row.
